title: Add dynamic OG image generation for blog posts using next/og
description: Generate dynamic Open Graph images for blog posts using Next.js ImageResponse API. Each blog post will have a unique OG image with title, date, and author, improving social media click-through rates for blog discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: OG image generated dynamically with blog post title, publication date, and author name
og:image meta tag present in BlogPostLayout with correct URL pointing to /_og route
Image dimensions 1200×630 px with readable text contrast (WCAG AA) on colored background
OG image regenerates when blog post frontmatter updates (uses revalidateTag)
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/app/blog/_og/route.tsx (new ImageResponse handler accepting slug and returning PNG)
File to edit: site/app/blog/[slug]/layout.tsx (update generateMetadata to add og:image meta tag with dynamic URL)
Test command: curl -I 'http://localhost:3000/blog/_og?slug=singapore-work-pass' | grep -i 'content-type: image'

title: Implement JB News & Updates RSS widget on homepage
description: Add a React Server Component homepage widget that fetches and displays 3-5 curated RSS feed items from JB tourism boards and local event sources, refreshing hourly with graceful error fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget fetches from 3+ RSS sources (JB tourism, local events, travel blogs) with 5-second timeout
Displays up to 5 most recent feed items with title, publication date, and source name linking to original
Feed data cached for 1 hour to minimize external requests and improve homepage load time
If RSS fetch fails, widget displays cached items or fallback message without breaking page render
technicalNotes: File to create: site/lib/rss-fetcher.ts (async function fetchRSSFeeds returning array of { title, date, source, url } objects)
File to create: site/app/components/JBNewsWidget.tsx (RSC component using fetchRSSFeeds with revalidateTag caching)
File to edit: site/app/page.tsx (add <JBNewsWidget /> below testimonials section)
Test command: npx vitest run 'site/app/components/__tests__/JBNewsWidget.test.tsx' -t 'displays recent items'

title: Create /rooms page with HotelRoom schema and Offer pricing
description: Build a dedicated /rooms page showcasing all hostel room types with photos, amenities, pricing, and HotelRoom JSON-LD schema with Offer markup for improved Google Hotel search visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Page displays all room types (dorm 4-bed, dorm 6-bed, private single, double, family) with 3+ images each
HotelRoom JSON-LD schema includes Offer with price (MYR), priceCurrency, availability, and booking URL
Each room card shows amenities (A/C, WiFi, shared bathroom) and accessibility features (wheelchair accessible)
Room pricing matches current booking system; schema validates against schema.org HotelRoom and Offer types
technicalNotes: File to create: site/app/rooms/data.ts (export roomTypes array with id, name, price, images, amenities, accessibility)
File to create: site/app/rooms/page.tsx (RSC page rendering room grid using shadcn Card component)
File to edit: site/lib/structured-data.ts (add generateHotelRoomSchema(room, priceRange) function returning JSON-LD)
Test command: npx vitest run 'site/lib/__tests__/structured-data.test.ts' -t HotelRoom

title: Add /visa-run resource hub page with FAQPage schema
description: Create a dedicated /visa-run page for visitors extending stay visas, featuring FAQ section, step-by-step border-crossing guide, and FAQPage JSON-LD schema for Google search result enhancements.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ accordion with 6+ Q&A pairs covering visa rules, timing, border crossing locations, transport costs, and logistics
Step-by-step visual guide showing JB→Singapore→JB route (3-5 steps with estimated timings and cost breakdown)
FAQPage JSON-LD schema with mainEntity array containing Question/Answer pairs for Google rich results
Internal links to related blog posts (Singapore work pass guide, JB accommodation, transport without car) placed contextually
technicalNotes: File to create: site/app/visa-run/page.tsx (RSC page with Accordion component from shadcn/ui for FAQs)
File to create: site/app/visa-run/data.ts (export visaRunFAQs array and borderGuide steps with timings)
File to edit: site/lib/structured-data.ts (add generateFAQPageSchema(faqItems) function for JSON-LD)
File to edit: site/app/sitemap.ts (add /visa-run route with priority 0.8)
Test command: npx vitest run 'site/lib/__tests__/structured-data.test.ts' -t FAQPage

title: Build /singapore-jobs resource hub for Malaysian job seekers
description: Create /singapore-jobs landing page targeting Malaysians seeking employment in Singapore, featuring work pass comparison table, job-seeker FAQ with schema, and cross-links to related blog content.
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison table displaying Singapore work pass types (EP, S Pass, PEP, WP) with eligibility, salary thresholds, and validity
FAQ section with 8+ job-seeker questions (salary expectations, application timeline, costs, requirements, visa runs allowed)
FAQPage JSON-LD schema with mainEntity array for Google search result FAQ snippets
Internal links to blog posts (How to Find Jobs in Singapore, Singapore Work Pass Guide, Visa Run) placed in context
